tray.blockedAlways: VPN traffic closed until you connect

boot.notAnswering: The Poros core is not answering. If it stays so, Poros restarts it by itself.
boot.downHint: Connecting and the settings are unavailable until the core starts.
boot.damaged: The data file of Poros is damaged, as a sudden power cut may leave it. Poros can start with clean data: the subscriptions and settings will have to be added again, and the old file stays in the data folder.

logs.title: Log
logs.empty: The log is empty so far.

about.all: Everything goes through the server, the local network directly.
about.hardened: Like All traffic, plus TLS fragmentation. Helps when the connection keeps breaking.

wizard.tagline: Quick setup takes less than a minute.

subscription.title: Add a subscription
subscription.text: Paste the link from your provider, and Poros will load its servers. It usually comes in an email or from a bot after payment.
subscription.label: Subscription link

start.title: How to start Poros
start.autostartHint: Poros opens when you sign in.
start.autoConnectHint: Right after it starts, Poros connects to the server that worked last time.
start.urlSchemeHint: A link from a site or a messenger opens straight in Poros.
start.note: Windows keeps autostart and links outside the Poros folder. They can be turned off in the settings.

routing.title: Which traffic goes through the server
routing.note: The preset can be changed at any time on the main screen.

portal.lockTitle: Kill switch: VPN traffic goes only through the server

hint.both: TUN takes all of the computer's traffic through the server, and System also points programs at the proxy directly.
hint.tun: All of the computer's traffic goes through the server, games and programs included.
hint.system: Browsers and programs that use the system proxy go through the server.
hint.none: Without TUN and System only programs set to the proxy {address} go through the server.

portal.blockedAlways: VPN traffic closed until you connect
portal.heldTitle: The kill switch keeps VPN traffic from going out directly until the connection is back. What the preset sends directly still works. Stop lets all traffic out without the VPN.
portal.heldFullTitle: The Poros core restarted without rights, and TUN is not running: until it is back, Windows closes the whole internet except Poros and the local network. Connect again with rights, or press Stop to open the internet without the VPN.

list.emptyText: Paste a subscription link, and its servers will show up here.
list.removeText: “{name}” and its servers will be gone from Poros.

add.title: Add a subscription
add.name: Name
add.note: The subscription shows up on the main screen as a group of its own.

modes.title: How traffic goes through the server
modes.tun: All of the computer's traffic, games and programs without proxy settings included. Needs administrator rights.
modes.system: Browsers and programs that use the Windows system proxy. No rights needed.
modes.note: Both can be on. The choice is remembered; the switches are on the main screen under Start.

admin.title: TUN needs administrator rights
admin.text: TUN creates a network adapter in Windows, which only an administrator may do. The Poros core restarts with rights and connects to the server right away.
admin.failed: TUN did not start without administrator rights.
admin.killSwitchTitle: The kill switch with TUN needs administrator rights
admin.killSwitchText: In the Always mode Poros keeps TUN up even without a connection, so that VPN traffic does not go around the server. TUN creates a network adapter in Windows, which only an administrator may do.
admin.killSwitchFailed: The kill switch did not turn on without administrator rights.

killSwitch.broken: The kill switch is not working, so VPN traffic can go out directly. The reason is in the log.

updates.killSwitch: The kill switch is off during the restart.
updates.reconnect: The connection comes back by itself.

failed.busy: The update to {version} did not install: a file is held by another program. Poros runs the previous version.
failed.damaged: The update to {version} did not install: the archive is damaged. Poros runs the previous version.
failed.failed: The update to {version} did not install. Poros runs the previous version; the reason is in the log.

ip.title: IP and DNS
ip.connectFirst: Connect to see the exit address.
ip.unknown: The address could not be found.
ip.dns: DNS servers that see your queries
ip.noConnection: DNS leaks are checked through the connection. Press Start, and the check runs by itself.
ip.noLeakText: Only DNS servers on the VPN side see your queries.
ip.leakText: Some queries go past the server, and your provider sees which sites you open. Turn on TUN or a preset with DNS through the server.
ip.unknownLeak: A leak cannot be told: the provider without VPN is unknown.
ip.note: To check, Poros resolves a few random names and asks an outside service which DNS servers asked for them.
ip.off: The IP and DNS check is off in the settings.

restartBanner.text: The settings changed. Apply them to the connection? It breaks for a couple of seconds.

presets.lead: A preset decides which traffic goes through the server and which goes directly. Built-in presets do not change: to add your own settings, make a copy or a new preset.
presets.none: No presets of your own yet.
presets.removeText: “{name}” will be gone. If it is chosen, Poros goes back to “{base}”.

conn.lead: How Poros connects and what it does when the connection breaks. TUN and System are on the main screen.

killSwitchHint.off: The internet is not blocked, even if the connection to the server breaks.
killSwitchHint.connected: If the connection to the server breaks, VPN traffic does not go out directly until you press Stop. The rest of the internet works.
killSwitchHint.always: While Poros runs, VPN traffic goes only through the server and is closed without a connection. The rest of the internet works. With TUN, needs administrator rights from the start.

conn.allowLanHint: A phone or TV on this network can go out through Poros. On the first connection Windows Firewall asks about PorosCore: allow it on private networks.
conn.checkIpHint: Before and after connecting, Poros asks an outside service for the IP and DNS servers. Click the IP for details and DNS leaks.
conn.ipv6Hint: Off, sites open over IPv4 only, and IPv6 connections do not go past the server.
conn.realityHint: VLESS servers with REALITY run on Xray. Off, they run on sing-box.
conn.killSwitchNote: How the kill switch works: VPN traffic is what the preset sends through the server. If the connection breaks, Poros keeps TUN and System on and refuses in place of the server: sites and programs the preset sends directly still work. With TUN, while the Poros core restarts, Windows closes the whole internet except Poros and the local network. Stop lifts the kill switch in the While connected mode, and so does choosing Off.

subs.lead: How the server list is updated.
subs.viaProxyHint: Helps when the provider's site cannot be reached directly.
subs.showChangesHint: After an update by hand, show which servers came and went.
subs.deviceInfoHint: Needed by providers that limit the number of devices.

start.lead: The same as the Start step of quick setup.
start.startMinimizedHint: The window does not open, Poros stays in the tray.
start.closeToTray: Hide to the tray on close
start.closeToTrayHint: Off, the close button quits Poros.
start.urlSchemeOther: Another copy of Poros opens them now: {program}. Turn on to let this one open them.
start.autostartOnly: Works when Poros starts with Windows.
start.adminAutostartHint: At sign-in, TUN and the kill switch come on without asking for rights. Poros creates a Task Scheduler task for this, and Windows asks for permission once.
start.runAsAdminHint: Windows asks for permission at every start, and then TUN and the kill switch ask nothing. The Poros window runs without rights.

look.lead: Language and size of the interface.

help.wizardHint: Go through the first-start steps again.
help.logsHint: What Poros did and what went wrong. The files are in the config\logs folder next to the program.
help.resetHint: Restarts the core if TUN stopped working.
help.ready: Version {version} is downloaded and ready to install.
help.checkFailed: The update check did not work. Current version: {version}.
help.local: A local build without a version does not update itself.
help.noUpdater: Current version: {version}. Without updater.exe next to it this build does not update itself.
help.autoCheckHint: At launch and every 4 hours. An update installs only when you press the button.
help.debugLogHint: Records every connection through Poros. Errors are always recorded. Takes effect with the next connection.

linkPreset.title: Add the preset from the link?
linkPreset.text: The preset “{name}” goes to “My presets”. The preset in use does not change.

presetEdit.name: Name
presetEdit.defaultHint: Where everything goes that the lists and rules above do not take.
presetEdit.defaultBlocked: Only the listed sites and apps will work. Poros blocks the rest.

presetLists.title: Lists of “{name}”
presetLists.hint: One site, IP, subnet or program (steam.exe or a full path) per line. Lines starting with # are skipped. A ready list can be pasted whole.
presetLists.locked: Locked rules are not part of the lists.
presetLists.invalid: {n} line not recognized: {lines}. Fix or remove it. | {n} lines not recognized: {lines}. Fix or remove them.
presetLists.duplicate: Already on other tabs: {lines}. Keep each line on one tab only.

reason.port_busy: port 2090 is taken by another program
reason.tun_busy: Windows still holds the TUN adapter of an earlier start. Try again; if that does not help, restart Windows
reason.system_proxy_failed: the system proxy could not be set
reason.server_unsupported: Poros cannot connect to this server
reason.kill_switch_needs_elevation: the kill switch needs administrator rights
reason.logon_task_needs_elevation: rights at autostart need administrator rights
reason.logon_task_failed: Windows did not create the Task Scheduler task
reason.kill_switch_failed: the kill switch did not turn on
reason.stop_timeout: the connection did not close in time; reset it in Help
reason.invalid_subscription: this does not look like a subscription
reason.no_servers: the subscription has no servers Poros can connect to
reason.invalid_url: a subscription link starts with http:// or https://
reason.single_server: This is a link to one server, not a subscription. Poros adds subscriptions only for now.
reason.check_failed: a part of the check failed
reason.invalid_entry: this is no site, address, subnet or program
reason.invalid_link: this is no Poros preset link
reason.update_failed: the update check did not work
reason.update_unavailable: this build does not update itself
reason.update_not_ready: no update is downloaded, or it changed after the download
reason.core_timeout: the Poros core did not answer in time
reason.core_start_failed: the Poros core did not start
reason.preset_name_taken: a preset of this name exists already
reason.check_off: the IP and DNS check is off in the settings

links.unknown: Poros does not know this link: {link}
